biography.value: Rockborn transition Stone Nephilim from obstacles into active threats. Crushing Slam builds toward Grapple and the ongoing damage that Grapple provides. Stone Grip makes escape from that Grapple genuinely difficult. A summoner who wants something held in place while allies deal with it elsewhere will find a Rockborn with a Grappled target the most efficient delivery mechanism available at this tier.

system.attacksNotes:
Crushing Slam [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 3), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (7 + 5 Str).
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up); target knocked Prone + Grappled; no save; Grappled target takes 6 bludgeoning damage at the start of each of their turns.
  • Margin 3: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone + Grappled + Restrained; ongoing damage increases to 10.

Boulder Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 4 + Ranged Combat 2), Range: 60/120 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (8 + 4 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up); target knocked Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Immovable: Cannot be knocked Prone by non-magical forced movement. Shoves automatically fail unless the attacker wins an opposed Strength + Athletics [Hard] check. Earth Bond: While on natural earth or stone, regains 4 HP at the start of its turn. Suppressed if it took magical damage this round. Powerful Build: Rockborn counts as Huge for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Stone Grip: Creatures Grappled by the Rockborn add 1 to both dice on Athletics, Acrobatics, and Might checks to escape.
system.reactionsNotes: Stone Skin [Reaction]: Once per round when hit by a physical attack, reduce incoming damage by 4.
